To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the default JPEG 2000 encoding settings do not provide the best image quality for visual tasks that are clinically relevant for X-ray coronary angiography.
JPEG 2000 can be tuned to improve model and human observer detectability in the SKEV task.
the JPEG 2002 encoder settings different from default ones result in greatly improved model observer performance in the clinically relevant visual tasks studied using real angiography images.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the evaluation of JPEG 20000 encoder options using human and model observers for clinically relevant visual signal detection tasks in X-ray coronary angio-graphy.

the development of a new image coding standard that is optimized for the human visual system and for the detection of clinically relevant visual tasks, and that is applicable in the field of medical image processing.
the effect of the JPEG 20000 encoder settings on the performance of human observers and on the performance of model observers in the SKEV and SKS visual tasks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
JPEG 2000 is a viable compression standard for digital angiographic image archiving and communication.
JPEG 2000 can be used to compress angiograms without any significant loss in observer performance for the studied tasks.
JPEG 2000 compression is not a problem for the detection of coronary artery stenosis in X-ray coronary angiocardiography.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
JPEG 2000 is a promising image compression standard for digital medical imaging.
the new JPEG 2000 standard is an effective compression technique for medical images.
for the investigated visual tasks, JPEG 2000 compression can be performed with a very small loss in observer detectability.
The main takeaway from our work is that
model observers can provide a useful tool for the optimization of image compression parameters for medical applications.
the JPEG 2001 encoder settings should be carefully optimized for each application.
JPEG 2000 can be used for lossy compression of X-ray angiography without loss of diagnostic performance.
